extracted.name: Joyce’s Simple Pizza Sauce
extracted.description: This is a quick and easy sauce for pizza made with tomato sauce, basil, Italian seasoning, onion, and sugar.
instruction_lines: Stir tomato sauce, sugar, basil, Italian seasoning, and minced onion together in a saucepan over medium heat; bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, and cook for 10 minutes.
